stamp.doc_section: Level 1 / KG Layer 2 — kind library (T-SQL predicates)
stamp.doc_stamp: v1.0.0 (ratified 2026-09-05, Sunny); v1.1.0 amendments per the twin-graph ruling, ADR 0077 (2026-09-06)

rulings_applied_at_conversion: RG-1 ruling (2026-09-05): quantifier is a predicate property

ReadMe_Rules.Design rule / note: v0.2 — RECONCILED 2026-09-04 against the ratified design doc (KG Layer 2: unit, node types, edge families, 8 rules) and Sunny's rulings R1-R5. Companion of the doc's KG Layer 2 section; the doc is the authority.
One meaning, one kind. Kinds name meanings, never syntax. Two syntaxes with the same meaning map to one kind; the syntax difference survives only in evidence.
Finite and versioned. Closed set; grows only by versioned change (doc -> registry -> code, never code-first) with a conformance case authored BEFORE the change.
Totality against the vendor denominator (reflected, never hand-typed): every vendor construct mapped or deferred-with-reason, both directions.
The mapper never guesses. No kind -> counted remainder (reason + location + raw evidence).
Per the ratified doc: predicates are nodes owned by exactly one scope; role-labeled contains edges to their expression children; evidence + version stamps on every node.

Structure_Kinds.Notes: An OR is a NODE — no walk can silently read it as AND.

R1 RATIFIED 2026-09-04: NOT LIKE / NOT IN / NOT BETWEEN / IS NOT NULL / NOT EXISTS normalize to NOT over the positive kind; original syntax kept in evidence. One meaning, one kind; 'all pattern-match decisions' is one graph query.

Structure_Kinds.Meaning: syntax only — shapes the tree, then dissolves
Structure_Kinds.Notes: The tree structure IS the grouping.

Predicate_Kinds.Meaning (one sentence): subject is one of an enumerated set of values
Predicate_Kinds.Roles: subject, comparand (one per member, ordered by position)
Predicate_Kinds.Notes: A DIFFERENT kind from IN_SELECTION: enumerated values vs delegation to data.

Predicate_Kinds.Meaning (one sentence): subject is a member of another selection's result — the decision's content lives in DATA (the value-set case)
Predicate_Kinds.Notes: The clinical value-set pattern; queryable on its own. Detection is STRUCTURAL (the comparand is a subquery_ref), never string-matching.

Predicate_Kinds.Meaning (one sentence): subject falls between a lower and an upper bound, inclusive

Predicate_Kinds.T-SQL syntax -> this kind: IS NULL (IS NOT NULL via NOT)

Predicate_Kinds.Meaning (one sentence): at least one row exists in another selection (usually correlated)
subject compares against every/any row of a selection
Predicate_Kinds.Notes: RG-1 RULED 2026-09-05 (Sunny): comparison-op and quantifier are PROPERTIES of the predicate node, never roles — roles are edges to expression children, and an operator/quantifier is not an expression. The Roles sheet's quantifier row retires under the same ruling; roles stay a pure edge vocabulary.

Predicate_Kinds.Meaning (one sentence): Degenerate predicates (1=1): map to their comparison kind; 'decides nothing' is a DERIVED fact (lens). CASE in predicate position: a comparison whose subject is a case expression node. Parameter defaults: IF structure + NULL_CHECK + assignment; 'parameter default' is a derived pattern. Decisions themselves: LENSES, never kinds (graph-leads ruling).

Roles.Meaning: what the predicate speaks about (the left-hand meaning)

the value/expression compared against; IN-list members are one comparand edge each, ordered by the contains edge's position property (reconciled: the former comparand-list role is retired — position owns order)
the two ends of a RANGE
the match pattern (and optional escape) of PATTERN_MATCH
a subquery scope used as the comparand (IN_SELECTION, EXISTS_SELECTION, QUANTIFIED_COMPARE) — reached via a subquery_ref child's resolves_to

Role labels ride the contains edges from predicate to expression children (ratified edge design). Without them a predicate knows which columns participate but not what it SAYS about them — the recorded misattribution bug class.

Expression_Kinds.Meaning: a MENTION of a column; resolves_to a KG layer 1 column node (or no edge = counted unresolved)
a MENTION of a table; resolves_to a KG layer 1 table OR a scope in the same tree (CTE / #temp stage) — ADDED in the ratified doc (a FROM references tables)
a constant value, owned by the predicate side
a mention of a parameter; resolves_to the file's parameter node
function application over ordered child expressions
value branching (WHENs hold predicates, THENs hold expressions)
sign/negation on a value (in the ratified doc list — R6 ratified 2026-09-04)
a mention of a nested selection used as a value; resolves_to its scope node

TSQL_Denominator.Detail / reason: NOT (all negated syntax normalizes here — R1 ratified)
COMPARE_* — all 11 enum values: 6 operators + 2 NEQ syntaxes + 2 legacy synonyms; *= / =* deferred (row below)
IN_LIST / IN_SELECTION (structural split: subquery_ref comparand vs literal members)
pre-1992 outer-join syntax, removed from modern SQL Server; counted remainder if ever seen

SQL 2022 null-safe equality; revisit on first estate sighting. CORRECTED at conversion 2026-09-05: ScriptDom actually emits DistinctPredicate — the draft's guessed type name would have broken the reflected-denominator check; caught by the F7 remainder case at the slice-2 build.
full-text search; rare in analytical estates
SQL graph tables, out of scope
trigger-context / legacy constructs, not analytical logic
the reflection check fails until the new type is mapped or deferred here with a reason

Test_Artifacts.What is authored (BEFORE any mapper code: one smallest SQL file per kind + authored expected tree + expected remainder (empty)

the recorded corpse catalog: OR shapes, derived-table scope, RANGE over columns, IN_SELECTION value sets, CTE referenced twice, 1=1, CASE-in-predicate, temp-table staging chains, negated forms (R1), nested control-flow statements
files containing each deferred construct, expecting exactly that counted remainder
same meaning in two dialects -> identical trees modulo evidence (arrives with dialect #2)

Meaning_Node_Kinds.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 2d: the closed meaning-node library — one kind per translated node in KG2b, the meaning twin. Doc is authority.
a scope's meaning; carries grain where derivable
a FROM/JOIN ref w/ join kind; resolves to a KG1 table or a same-tree selection node (the handle)
Meaning_Node_Kinds.Deciding example: INNER JOIN #Base_Pop -> 'restricted to records also present in the base-population selection'

Meaning_Node_Kinds.Definition: a predicate's meaning; kinds = the ratified R4 closed set; DEGENERATE is a subkind — translated always, voiced never
Meaning_Node_Kinds.Deciding example: DX_CODE LIKE 'E11%' -> 'the diagnosis code starts with E11'; WHERE 1=1 -> degenerate

Meaning_Node_Kinds.Definition: what an output column IS (rides the A12 un-deferral)
Meaning_Node_Kinds.Deciding example: FIRST_TIME_LINE = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) -> 'the first scored row per encounter'
GROUP BY ENCOUNTER_ID -> 'one row per encounter'

Meaning_Node_Kinds.Definition: ORDER BY/TOP/window functions; shapes which rows
Meaning_Node_Kinds.Deciding example: TOP 1 ORDER BY SCORE DESC -> 'the highest-scoring row'

Meaning_Node_Kinds.Definition: an operand's meaning (the R5 material as nodes)
a counted untranslated node; reason-coded per the 0044 pattern
